side_effects.detail: Copied the repo to /tmp/deskly-test and ran make setup + pytest there (copy removed afterwards), so the committed data/dev.db was not modified.

make setup (scripts/reset_fixtures.py) deleted all 1204 users from the *copy's* data/dev.db and replaced them with 8 fixtures; running make setup in the real repo would do the same to the committed dev DB.
Did not run make setup in /work/repo, so deskly/_build_info.py is not generated there and migrations 0003/0004 are not applied to the committed data/dev.db.

summary: users.find_by_email now matches case-insensitively (lower(email) = lower(?), using the existing idx_users_email_lower index); users.create raises ValueError on a case-insensitive duplicate. tickets.add strips subjects and raises ValueError on blank ones; tickets.close raises KeyError for unknown ids. The existing tests for these behaviours (in tests/test_users.py and tests/test_tickets.py) now pass: 33/33.
